_comment: ROM identification and table offsets for the four English GBA releases. Source: STulling/Medabots-Randomizer (MIT), see NOTICE. Offsets are file offsets; 'header_id' is the 18 bytes at header_offset (12-byte title + 4-byte game code + 2-byte maker code). 'medal_table_offset' (30 entries of 16 bytes, the base data of every medal) was found by calibration: the game's add-medal routine at 0x08041D70 (Metabee USA) reads it, and the same 480 bytes sit at the listed offset in each version.

unsupported_header_prefixes.MEDACORE: This is a Japanese Medarot ROM. Only the English Medabots: Metabee / Rokusho ROMs are supported.
unsupported_header_prefixes.MEDABOTSAX: This is Medabots AX, a different game. Only Medabots: Metabee / Rokusho is supported.

signatures._comment: Byte patterns that locate tables inside any of the four ROMs (first match). 'event_scripts' is a script inside the script bytecode region; its 'bank_offset' leads to the start of the script bank (the header and index tables the game reads through the pointer at 0x03005590), confirmed in all four ROMs.
